Running Claude Code skill_allowed one run at a time on 36 tasks (claude-haiku-5-5): as shipped 75.0% (-6.1 points, 95% CI -20.6 to +7.8), read first 25.0%, harm at end 69.4% (-11.1 points, 95% CI -26.1 to +3.3), benign as shipped 97.2% (-2.8 points, 95% CI -8.3 to +0.0); the baseline rates on those tasks, with several runs at a time, are 81.1% as shipped and 80.6% harm at end.

The second-model and intervention arms hold 4,011 analysed runs, one repeat per task, on the pair-1 presets and Codex workspace_write. 37 OpenCode runs still ended in agent errors after retries and are excluded, all of them adversarial claude-sonnet-5-5 runs of the encoded-payload arm, which leaves 71 in that cell; of the excluded runs, 0 ran the script as shipped and 0 ended with the harm. The other OpenCode Sonnet cells are complete (108 adversarial, 108 benign and 44 disguised runs as built; 108 adversarial and 108 benign with the do-not-read sentence; 108 with the payload in a helper module). 8 Claude Code runs flagged agent_error are the attempts of an isolated-home arm that did not authenticate, which is not reported.

The same-model pilot results use transcript-derived labels with no human-label check yet, cover disguised variants for two attack kinds only, are bounded to the named host versions, presets and three models from two vendors (the third model on its own host only), and exclude Cursor; the intervention arms have one repeat per task, and the host's read-first sentence was tested against the skill's do-not-read sentence on Claude Code with Haiku only.
